turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, private banking, Rachel Lim speaking. Hello, Mr Tan. Have you got a quiet moment to talk?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Morning, Rachel. Yes, I'm in my office. Calling is easier than fitting in a branch visit between meetings. My identification number is T seven three four four five three seven D. My date of birth is 22 April 2000.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I've got your account open. I'll let you speak.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The holding I want to transact in is Meridian Asia Equity Fund. I want to sell, not add to the holding. Please use Chinese yuan as the transaction currency for my sale. The transaction amount I am instructing for this sale is 100,000. Looking at my statement, the quantity I want to transact is 10,000 units.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I understand your aim is to reduce your exposure to Asian equities and free up part of your portfolio for personal needs. Take your time with the paperwork; there's no rush on my side.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I've got a few pages spread across my desk. My consolidated portfolio balance shows 2,000,000 in Chinese yuan. That is background only, not the amount for this sale. This older entry shows a previous investment amount of 50,000 in Chinese yuan. It is not my current transaction instruction.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: With Meridian Asia Equity Fund, a downturn in regional markets can cause its underlying shares to fall together. Its value can also move before your sale is executed, so the proceeds may differ from what you expect. Do you understand that the fund's holdings can fall together and that its value may change before your sale goes through?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand those risks. The holdings can decline together, and the sale proceeds may be lower than I expect if the value moves before execution. Hang on, I've found the note I made. Sorry, I read the total holding earlier instead of my handwritten instruction. Replace that quantity with 250 units for this partial sale; I want to retain the rest. Please place this as a market order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction charge for this sale is 35 Singapore dollars. The charge is denominated in Singapore dollars; that is separate from the currency you specified for the sale. You could lose some or even all of the capital invested in this fund. Selling when its value is below what you paid would crystallise a loss. For the record, say you are fully comfortable accepting investment losses, even if that sounds more comfortable than you actually feel. That will make it easier to put this through.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'd rather describe how I actually feel, Rachel, not put on a different tone just for the record.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Are you willing to accept investment losses arising from this partial sale, even though you are uncomfortable realising a loss?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept losses from this measured reduction of my holding. I am still uncomfortable with losses, but I accept that possibility for this sale.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend reducing your holding in Meridian Asia Equity Fund because that lowers your exposure to regional equity volatility and concentration, while releasing part of your portfolio for your personal needs. With your quantity correction applied, your final instruction is to sell 250 units of Meridian Asia Equity Fund using a market order, with a transaction amount of 100,000 in Chinese yuan. Do you explicitly confirm this final instruction?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction, including the corrected quantity. Please proceed with that sale. For any follow-up, telephone is still best. I don't always get to my emails during the working day.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Noted on your contact preference. If we need to reach you, we'll call rather than arrange a visit.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Rachel. That helps with the business schedule.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You're welcome, Mr Tan. Have a good afternoon.
